summary.text: MAGNUSVEGEN 14 AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2006-11-23. It was previously named MAGNUSVEIEN 14 EIENDOM AS until 2025-06-25. Its registered activity: "Investere i fast eiendom eller selskaper som eier fast eiendom, og alt som dermed står i forbindelse." Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 12 309 732 NOK and the annual result was 7 810 110 NOK; operating income was up from 12 205 111 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 6 569 052 NOK in 2024 to 7 810 110 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 20 954 783 NOK in 2024 to 21 305 848 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Dag Kaalsaas (styrets leder), with 2 other board members. The register's most recent update was on 2026-06-18 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
